rules.condition: extra = og.min(og.fdiv(magicpoints, 20), C.SHOT_DRAIN_CAP); magicpoints -= extra; weapon.damage += extra
rules.semantic: Every weapon an archmage fires drains a twentieth of the MP it has left after the shot's cost, capped at SHOT_DRAIN_CAP (50, so the cap binds only above 1000 MP), and adds the drained amount to that shot's damage.

arms.observable: MP == M - weapon_cost - (M - weapon_cost)/20; shot damage == base + (M - weapon_cost)/20
MP == M - weapon_cost - 50; shot damage == base + 50

tests.note: uncapped arm only, at 1000 MP; the control archmage at weapon_cost MP pins zero drain

rules.condition: if self.level >= 40 then period = 1 else period = 40 - level; if og.mod(drawcycle, period) == 0 then view_all + 1
rules.semantic: An archmage's magical sight (view_all) grows by one every (40 - level) ticks of its own act counter, every tick from level 40.

rules.condition: if lc.spare_mp(self, 3) >= self:s_special_cost(3) then shifter 1 else 0
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: a bot archmage picks SUMMON ELEMENTAL only when the pool left after the slot-3 price still covers that price again (1000+ MP for the 500 slot); otherwise SUMMON IMAGE.

rules.condition: if i < C.NUM_SPECIALS and self.magicpoints >= self:s_special_cost(i)
rules.semantic: A struck archmage can only answer with a special its level unlocks ((L+2)/3 slots) and its MP covers.

rules.condition: if self:has_guy() then threshold = 3/5 max_hp else 3/8 max_hp
rules.semantic: A struck hero archmage flees (teleports) below 60% health; a monster archmage is braver and waits until 3/8.

rules.condition: if self.hp < threshold and possible[1] and og.rand(3) ~= 0 then (teleport) else (fight back)
rules.semantic: A struck archmage under its flee threshold teleports away two times in three (rand(3) drawn only when hurt and TELEPORT affordable); otherwise it turns on its attacker.

rules.anchor: local _ = lc.mid_teleport(self) or self:special()  -- struck mid-teleport: no second cast
rules.condition: local _ = lc.mid_teleport(self) or self:special()
rules.semantic: An archmage struck again while already mid-teleport casts nothing more (no second teleport).

rules.condition: if self:foe() ~= foe then foe both ways, distances 15000
rules.semantic: A struck archmage that is not already fighting its attacker takes the attacker as its foe, and the attacker takes it back; its range memory resets.

rules.anchor: if gf.on() and not self:seat_driven() then
rules.condition: if gf.on() and not self:seat_driven() then if possible[2] then shifter=rand(2); current_special=2; if ai_burst_or_chain(self) then special() end end return
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: a struck bot archmage answers only with HEARTBURST or CHAIN LIGHTNING, chosen by the slot-2 gate (coin drawn first as classic did), at most once; it never summons from the hit response. A seat-driven archmage keeps the classic response.

arms.when: fixes on, bot, slot 2 affordable, target in reach
arms.observable: exactly one EXPLOSION or CHAIN, no summon

arms.when: fixes on, bot, no target in either radius

rules.condition: if foe_count ~= 0 then if possible[3] then current_special=3; if special() then return
rules.semantic: Classic: a struck archmage with a foe within 200 px first tries SUMMON (slot 3) with whatever Shift was left over (stale coin: image or elemental), and stops there if it worked.

rules.condition: if possible[2] then if rand(2)~=0 then shifter 1 (chain) special(); if ok and mp>=cost(1) then busy=0 special() ... else shifter 0 (burst) special(); if ok and mp>=cost(1) then busy=0 special()
rules.semantic: Classic: failing a summon, a struck archmage casts CHAIN LIGHTNING half the time (else HEARTBURST), and if that worked and it can still afford a TELEPORT it casts AGAIN at once - but slot 2 is still selected, so the 'then leave' follow-up is a second heartburst, not a teleport. A failed chain falls through to heartburst.

arms.observable: one CHAIN plus one heartburst EXPLOSION per foe, no teleport

rules.condition: if not gf.on() then true; mark = foe_count<1 and marker_pays; if mark and not busy then shifter 1 else 0; return (foe_count<1 or foe_count>3) and not mid_teleport
rules.semantic: Classic: a bot archmage teleports on every TELEPORT roll. Gameplay Fixes: it teleports (the mage's rule) only when nobody is within 110 px or more than three foes are, never mid-teleport; with nobody near it plants a TELEPORT MARKER instead (Shift 1) when it has no marker standing, a hero has 75 INT, the pool after the price still covers HEARTBURST, and it is not busy.

rules.condition: if not gf.on() true; busy false; if shifter then (in_chain>=1 true else shifter 0, in_burst>=1) else (in_burst true; in_chain -> shifter 1 true; false)
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: a bot's slot-2 cast keeps the coin's arm when that arm has a foe in its radius (heartburst 80+2L, chain 200+5L+2L), swaps to the other arm when only it has one, and is refused when neither has a foe or the archmage is busy.

arms.when: coin chain, foe in chain radius
coin burst, foe in burst radius

rules.condition: if not gf.on() true; busy false; summon_shift; if shifter then foes_within(200) ... hurt / owned_phantom / foes_at_blows / spare < cost(2) -> false; return #hunters(200) >= 2
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: a bot's SUMMON ELEMENTAL (pool-chosen) wants a living foe within 200 px; its SUMMON IMAGE is a decoy cast before blows land: two or more foes within 200 px hunting it, none at blows yet, its health above the flee threshold (60% hero, 3/8 monster), no phantom of its own standing, and a pool after the 500 that still covers HEARTBURST.

rules.condition: if not gf.on() true; busy false; return nearest_charmable(self, foes in 80+4L, self.level) ~= nil
rules.semantic: Gameplay Fixes: MIND CONTROL wants a foe it can take inside its reach: never charmed, not a seated hero, not above the archmage's level (the rest gate wraps it on both values).

rules.condition: if lc.mid_teleport(self) then SPECIAL BUSY; if shifter_down == 0 then (teleport out)
rules.semantic: TELEPORT unshifted sends the archmage out (ANI_TELE_OUT, teleport sound) unless it is already teleporting; Shift places/replaces a marker instead.

rules.condition: if lc.is_busy(self) then SPECIAL BUSY; if has_guy and int < 75 then 75 INT REQUIRED
rules.semantic: Placing a TELEPORT MARKER refuses a busy archmage and a hero with under 75 intelligence (monsters have no INT requirement), at no cost.

arms.observable: false '75 INT REQUIRED', MP and busy unchanged

rules.condition: if ob and ob:order()==FX and family==FX_MARKER and owner==self and dead()==0 then retire it, busy +8, break
rules.semantic: An archmage has at most one marker: placing a new one retires its own previous live marker (and only its own), costing 8 extra busy ticks.

arms.observable: old marker dead, '(Old Marker Removed)', busy +16 total, one live marker

rules.condition: if self.team == 0 or self:has_guy() then og.emit_notification(...)
rules.semantic: Marker messages ('(Old Marker Removed)', 'Teleport Marker Placed', '(N Uses)') are told only on the player's side or for a hero, addressed to the caster; unlike the mage they are not gated on user() (any team-0 bot also announces).

arms.observable: notifications emitted targeted at the caster

rules.condition: if has_guy then lifetime = int // 33 else level // 4 + 1
rules.semantic: A marker's number of uses is a hero's intelligence / 33, a monster's level / 4 + 1.

rules.condition: if lc.is_busy(self) then SPECIAL BUSY
rules.semantic: A busy archmage cannot cast HEARTBURST / CHAIN LIGHTNING.

rules.condition: if shifter then (has_guy: 200 + int//2 else 200 + 5L) else 80; + 2L
rules.semantic: HEARTBURST reaches foes within 80 + 2L px; CHAIN LIGHTNING acquires within 200 + Int/2 + 2L for a hero, 200 + 5L + 2L for a monster.

rules.condition: if foe_count == 0 then NO FOE IN RANGE
rules.semantic: HEARTBURST / CHAIN with no foe in reach fail free.

rules.condition: if self:shifter_down() == 0 then (heartburst) else (chain)
rules.semantic: HEARTBURST splits its MP pool evenly over every foe in reach, one magical explosion centred on each (on that foe's floor), spending the pool share per foe; CHAIN LIGHTNING spends the pool once on a single bolt.

arms.observable: N FAMILY_EXPLOSION each damage pool/N, MP -= pool, busy +5
one FAMILY_CHAIN with damage pool, MP -= pool, busy +5

rules.condition: if self:has_guy() then shots += foe_count (burst) / += 1 (chain)
rules.semantic: A hero's HEARTBURST counts one shot per foe it bursts; its CHAIN LIGHTNING counts one shot however many it hits (accuracy can exceed 100%).

rules.condition: if foe:floor() == self:floor() then if best_dist > dist then leader = foe
rules.semantic: CHAIN LIGHTNING's first strike is the nearest foe (centre distance) on the archmage's own floor; it cannot arc through floors.

arms.observable: bolt has no leader, MP still spent

rules.condition: if lc.is_busy(self) then SPECIAL BUSY
rules.semantic: A busy archmage cannot summon.

rules.condition: if self:shifter_down() ~= 0 then (true summon: elemental) else (illusion)
rules.semantic: SUMMON with Shift calls a real fire elemental; unshifted it conjures a one-hit-point phantom of a random class.

arms.observable: a phantom (FAMILY by tier) with hp 0, max_hp 1, name 'Phantom'

rules.anchor: if self:has_guy() and self:g_intelligence() < t.summon_int_req then
rules.condition: if has_guy and int < summon_int_req (150) then '150 INT REQUIRED'
rules.semantic: A hero needs 150 intelligence for the true summon; monsters do not.

rules.condition: if not gf.on() then halve_mp_surcharge (before placement) ... if gf.on() then halve_mp_surcharge (after placement)
rules.semantic: The true summon also takes half the MP left after its price. Classic: taken before the elemental is placed, so a summon with nowhere to stand still pays it. Gameplay Fixes: taken only once the elemental stands.

arms.observable: MP pays half the spare pool

rules.condition: if not ((i==0 and j==0) or placed) then if query_passable(testx,testy) then place ... if not placed then dead, NO ROOM TO SUMMON
rules.semantic: The elemental stands in the first passable of the eight neighbouring body-sized cells, scanned column by column from the west (i outer -1..1, j inner -1..1, skipping the caster's own cell); it is level (L+1)/2, the caster's team, owned, with elemental_lifetime(L). With no free cell the summon is cancelled.

arms.observable: no elemental, false 'NO ROOM TO SUMMON'

rules.condition: if mp_pool < 100 elf elseif < 250 rand(3) elseif < 500 rand(5) elseif < 1000 rand(7) else rand(9)
rules.semantic: The phantom's class widens with the magic left after the 500 price: under 100 always an elf (no draw); under 250 elf/soldier/archer; under 500 adds orc/skeleton; under 1000 adds druid/cleric; 1000+ adds elemental and orc captain; one rand draw for every tier but the first.

tests.note: table over tiers, rng state 4242 unchanged at tier 0

rules.condition: if not ((i==0 and j==0) or placed) then if query_passable then place phantom ... if not placed then dead, NO ROOM TO SUMMON
rules.semantic: The phantom stands in the first free neighbouring cell (same scan order as the elemental) as a level (L+2)/3, caster-team, owned decoy with image_lifetime(L), 1 max hp and 0 hp, no armour, magical, named 'Phantom', sharing the caster's foe; with no free cell the summon is cancelled.

arms.observable: phantom placed: owner, team, name 'Phantom', hp 0, max_hp 1, foe == caster's foe, busy +15
no phantom, false 'NO ROOM TO SUMMON'

rules.condition: if lc.is_busy(self) then SPECIAL BUSY; if foe_count < 1 then NO FOE IN RANGE
rules.semantic: MIND CONTROL refuses a busy archmage and needs a foe within 80 + 4L px; both refusals are free.

rules.condition: if budget < 10 then break
rules.semantic: MIND CONTROL takes foes while its budget lasts: the first is covered by the base price, each further one costs 10 MP of the spare pool; when the budget is gone the rest are left alone.

rules.anchor: if gf.charmable(foe, fixes) and foe:charm_left() <= 10 then
rules.condition: if gf.charmable(foe, fixes) and foe:charm_left() <= 10 then
rules.semantic: MIND CONTROL takes only never-charmed living foes with no charm running (and, with Gameplay Fixes, not a seated hero); others are skipped without spending budget.

rules.condition: if level_edge < 0 then confused else confused = rand(20)==0; if confused then berserk else control
rules.semantic: A foe above the archmage's level always resists (no draw) and an equal/lower one resists 1 in 20; a resisting foe goes berserk onto a random team (rand(8)) for charm_duration(edge) ticks; a controlled foe joins the archmage's team with no foe, for charm_duration(edge) ticks. Either way its real team is remembered.

arms.observable: team == caster team, foe()==nullptr, real_team == old team, charm_left == charm_duration(edge)

rules.anchor: if gf.on() and colour == self.team then
rules.condition: if gf.on() and colour == self.team then colour = (colour + 1) % 8
rules.semantic: Classic: a berserk foe's random colour can land on the archmage's own team, handing it over anyway. Gameplay Fixes: berserk always means someone else's side (own colour becomes the next one, 7 wraps to 0).

arms.observable: foe team = roll on both values

rules.condition: if controlled == 0 then NO VALID TARGET
rules.semantic: MIND CONTROL with foes in reach but none it can take fails free.

rules.condition: if mp_after_base_cost > 0 and controlled > 1 then spend min((controlled-1)*10, spare)
rules.semantic: Each foe controlled beyond the first costs 10 MP more, never more than the pool left after the base price.
